fields.v: Compares; secondary: Evaluates — controlled experiments comparing 8 rule-file conditions vs a no-rule baseline, rule counts, rule types, per-rule ablation and superposition (>5,000 runs); repository mining: corpus analysis and taxonomy of 679 rule files (25,532 rules) scraped from GitHub
fields.quote: We compare eight conditions on 58 tasks (Figure 1a): a no-rule baseline and seven rule conditions chosen to probe distinct properties of rule quality
fields.why: The value has two secondary natures (the protocol allows one) and the main design is a paired comparison of rule conditions against a no-rule baseline, which elsewhere (e.g. the AGENTS.md context-file study) is filed as Compares.
fields.doubt: O valor tem duas naturezas secundárias, mas o protocolo só permite uma. O núcleo do estudo são experiências que comparam condições de regras com uma linha de base sem regras (pág. 4-5). Decide se a natureza principal é Compares (com a mineração do GitHub como secundária Evaluates) ou se mantens Evaluates, ficando só uma secundária.

fields.v: Partly (0.5): one trajectory per task-condition in Exp. 1, 3 and 4 (only Exp. 2 averages 3 seeds), but paired McNemar, Cochran's Q, sign, Fisher and Mann-Whitney tests and a threshold-sensitivity analysis
fields.quote: The no-rule baseline also differs between Experiment 1 (50.0%, single trajectory per task) and Experiment 2 (60.3%, averaged over three seeds); part of this gap reflects the run-to-run stochasticity of single-trajectory agent evaluation
fields.where: §7 Discussion, Limitations (Statistical power and baseline variance), p. 9
fields.why: Most experiments use a single trajectory per task-condition and the authors note run-to-run stochasticity; a single run with statistical tests was scored Partly for the comparable AGENTS.md study, so Yes may be inconsistent.
fields.doubt: A maioria das experiências usa uma só execução por tarefa e condição; só a Exp. 2 tem 3 sementes, e os autores admitem variação entre execuções (pág. 9). Há testes estatísticos. Noutro estudo parecido (uma execução + testes) deste Parcial. Decide se Q8 fica Sim ou passa a Parcial.
